issues.description: The problem statement and UML require calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to be a static method (shared, using the static stock). The solution implementation declares calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (non-static). This mismatch between the specification and the reference solution can confuse students about whether the method should be static and may lead to implementing a different API than shown in the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the reference solution so calculateTotalPrice is declared static to match the problem statement and UML: change the method signature to 'public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)'. Ensure any internal usage accesses the static stock field and update any calls if necessary.
